facts.text: Lilly's tray for the Demonik testing crew.
facts.why: Alex's co-workers come to the house after they finish testing J.P.'s game, Eternal Deathslayer III. Demonik is Alex's own game, which he plays only with Lilly.
facts.fix: Lilly's tray for the work crew when Alex has to bring everyone home.

vibe.verdict: Wholesome grandma menu for a stoner comedy, with the film's big gags (Antiques Roadshow, the lion and monkey, the tea mix-up) missing.
missing: Lilly, Grace and Bea drinking Alex's pot as 'tea' (the house)
Antiques Roadshow tickets (the ladies' favourite show)
Dante's lion, swapped for a kung fu monkey (Dante's place)
The vegan restaurant and Shilo the waiter (the work dinner)
Lilly beating J.P. at Demonik (the finale)
ideas: Swap 'Lilly, Bea and Grace's peach iced tea' for 'Alex's tea tin', the one the ladies drank by mistake
Swap 'Grandma's cinnamon tea cake' for 'Antiques Roadshow tea and scones'
Swap 'Brainasium game tester pizza scrolls' for 'Eternal Deathslayer III pizza scrolls'
Swap the 'Ice cold cream soda' note for 'Lilly beat J.P. at Demonik, ice cold'
